title: One side's adjustments do not balance its own amounts
notes: Follows the entry's example: the vendor-processed side balances (500.00 - 108.00 = 392.00); the MAC-processed CLP04 and BPR02 are 390.00 with the same CAS, so 2.00 is unexplained on the MAC side (a legacy-side imbalance, e.g. a manual payment change without a matching adjustment). The line itself balances on both sides; only the claim-level identity fails on the MAC side.

imbalance.detail: claim 1 (SYN301A): CLP03 500.00 minus adjustments 108.00 = 392.00 but CLP04 is 390.00 (unexplained 2.00)
